unit: gzip bytes, KB = 1000 bytes. growth is the cumulative allowance over the 0.3.0 baseline after each 0.4.0 stage (null: no growth limit), cap is a fixed limit in bytes or the row budget of the report

groups.name: first MP4 under the 25.00 KB promise
groups.why: Stage 2 may spend 0.39 KB, stage 3 0.01 KB and stage 5 0.05 KB on the first MP4 path, and the three configurations that inline the worker stay at or below 24.95 KB, inside the 25.00 KB promise.

groups.name: first MP4 of the default configuration
groups.why: The same per-stage shares, under the 24.00 KB promise of the default configuration.

groups.name: first MP4 of the custom worker configurations
groups.why: The same per-stage shares, under the budgets of the custom configurations.

groups.name: standalone ISO BMFF worker file
groups.why: The prebuilt ISO BMFF worker carries the same parser code as the first MP4 path.

groups.name: Matroska path
groups.why: Stage 2 may spend 0.20 KB and stage 5 0.05 KB on the first MKV path, under the row budgets.

groups.name: both parsers in one file
groups.why: The single standalone worker holds both parsers, so it may grow by the ISO BMFF and the Matroska shares together.

groups.name: ISO BMFF parser chunk
groups.why: The parser chunk carries most of the first MP4 growth and stays under 13.00 KB.

groups.name: engine chunks
groups.why: The library engine chunks share the result helpers and may grow by 0.03 KB at most.

groups.name: critical path
groups.why: The package code in the entry chunk stays byte-identical to 0.3.0 for the whole release.

groups.name: critical path of the rule entries
groups.why: Byte-identical until stage 6, which adds the check rules and re-sets the preset budget.
